sections.title: Named gate limit
sections.text: Bindings whose concrete is a closure, `config()`-resolved class name, or other non-`::class` literal are listed as **не разбирается статически** (`static-limit`). The gate does not infer their constructors; remediation owners must review manually (same principle as P3 D17 — extend scanner, not new tool).
